name: Pell

lines.text: I keep the inner wall and I sweep the court. They are the same job to me: something arrives, and it has to go somewhere.
In mist, yes. Not every mist. You will want the stair and three days, and you will be the first person to sit them who was not being paid.
No. My father rebuilt this wall and I have rebuilt it and my son will. You are asking me to leave a job that is not finished, and it is never going to be finished, and that is not a reason.

notes: The one who will not come, and for the opposite reason to Bekh: not somebody has to stay, but the work does not end and that is not an argument for stopping. Sweeps an interdimensional gate as municipal maintenance.
